sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 420 (all pages via campsitePaging.do, 131 of 133 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included for campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/higley-flow-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=420 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'Looking to reserve a campsite for just 1 night? If you make your reservation within 3 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay online or through the RA Call Center (1-800-456-2267). *Applies to campsites only.'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Loops A, B and C are electric (53 sites at 30 amp, 7 at 50 amp in A and B); loops D, E and F have none. No full-hookup sites.

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 420 (Loop A: 16 x 30 amp, 4 x 50 amp; Loop B: 18 x 30 amp, 3 x 50 amp; Loop C: 19 x 30 amp; Loops D-F 'Electric Hookup - no'; 'Full Hookup - no' on all), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 133 campsites in six loops (A-F); listed equipment lengths 20-40 ft (81 at 30 ft, only 8 at 40 ft), all back-in on blacktop driveways.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/higley-flow-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=420 ('Campsite (133)'; 'campsites have blacktop driveways') + ReserveAmerica site list (Equip length/Driveway '30 Back-In' 81, '20 Back-In' 21, '35 Back-In' 21, '40 Back-In' 8), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/higley-flow-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=420 ('campgrounds have dumping stations and showers'; Services and Amenities 'Dump Station', 'Showers', 'Water Drinking', 'Water Fillup Station'), read 2026-10-21

note: OPRHP (Adirondack foothills) on Higley Flow (impounded Raquette River). Narrow camp roads. Beach, boat launch. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 420): reservable, 9-month window incl. same day, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, max rig 40 ft; sites 128 -> 133 (all back-in); added electric to 50-amp (loops A-C), showers, dump, drinking water. Season (2027 May 21 - Sep 5) matches; fees left as read 2026-10-12; phone 315-262-2880 matches. Water at sites (derived from the note) neither confirmed nor contradicted by the catalog.
